title: Net Fiddle Topology
description: Serialised format for a Net Fiddle network topology diagram. Produced by Export and consumed by Import. The top-level object contains two arrays: nodes (canvas elements) and edges (connections between them).

nodes.description: All nodes on the canvas. Must be ordered so that container nodes appear before any of their children (ReactFlow requirement).

nodeId.description: Unique identifier for a node within this topology.

handleId.description: Identifies a specific connector point. Format: {side}-{index}-{connector}. Side is N (north), E (east), S (south), or W (west). Index is 0-based within that side. Connector is 's' for source (solid dot) or 't' for target (hollow dot). Example: 'N-0-s' is the first source handle on the north side.

containerNode.description: A resizable namespace box. Other nodes can be nested inside it by setting their parentNode to this node's id.

position.description: Top-left corner of the box in absolute canvas coordinates.

zIndex.description: Render order. Use -1 to place the container behind its children (standard value for namespaces).

label.description: Display name shown in the container title bar.

netNode.description: A plain network component node (not a container).

position.description: Position relative to the parentNode's top-left corner if parentNode is set; absolute canvas coordinates otherwise.

parentNode.description: ID of the containerNode this node is nested inside. Omit for top-level nodes.

nodeType.description: Component type key. Determines which connector anchors and validation rules apply.

label.description: Human-readable name shown on the node card.

vethPairId.description: Shared pair identifier. Both ends of a veth or netkit pair carry the same value. Used to co-delete both ends and to identify the permanent pair-link edge. Required on veth-end, netkit-primary, and netkit-peer nodes.

nodeConfig.description: Optional runtime configuration. Only the fields relevant to the node's nodeType are used; all others are ignored.

direction.description: Applies to nodeType 'traffic-control'. Controls which flow direction the TC hook handles and which ordering step it occupies. Defaults to 'ingress' when omitted.

type.description: Applies to nodeType 'qdisc'. Selects the queuing discipline algorithm displayed in the properties panel. Defaults to 'fq' when omitted.

regularEdge.description: A user-drawn connection between two node handles.

sourceHandle.description: Handle on the source node (must be a source handle, suffix '-s').

targetHandle.description: Handle on the target node (must be a target handle, suffix '-t').

pairLinkEdge.description: The permanent virtual wire connecting both ends of a veth or netkit pair. Created automatically when a pair is dropped; cannot be reconnected or deleted independently.

vethLink.description: Flag that marks this edge as a permanent pair link. Causes the app to skip reconnect gestures and validation rules for this edge.

className.description: CSS class applied to hide the edge's reconnect drag handles.

style.description: Visual style for the dashed pair-link line.

label.description: Decorative label on the edge. The app uses '⛓' for pair links.
